options.title: Nutation Settings
options.subtitle: Choose an API gateway or direct provider preset, or Custom for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
options.uiLanguageHint: Language used by the extension interface. System default follows your browser.
options.apiUrlHint: Required for Custom. Paste the full OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint, including /chat/completions.
options.targetLanguageSearchPlaceholder: Search by language name or code
options.targetLanguageTypeToSearch: Type to search, then pick a language
options.translationMode.bulk.label: Full page (fewer requests)
options.translationMode.bulk.note: Translates the whole page in fewer, larger requests (default). Best when you can keep reading other tabs while this page finishes. New content after scroll uses smaller, faster batches.
options.translationMode.progressive.note: Translates near-viewport text first with small batches. Best when you want visible text to update as soon as possible. Uses more API requests overall and probably cost you more money.
options.summaryPositionHint: Where the AI summary panel opens. You can still cycle positions from the panel itself.
options.copyIncludeLink: Include the page link when copying page info
options.copyIncludeLinkHint: Copy page info copies the translated title and description, plus the link with tracking parameters (like utm_source) removed.
options.copySeparatorHint: Joins the title, description, and link when copying page info. Use \n for a line break or \t for a tab.
options.autoRecover: Auto-recover missing content script (inject, then reload page)
options.translateOnOpen.title: Translate on open
options.cache.title: Translation & summary cache
options.cache.description: Stores translation segments and page summaries. Clearing removes both.
options.error.targetLanguage: Pick a target language from the search results.
options.error.apiUrl: API URL is required for Custom provider.
options.error.formMissing: Settings form is missing required fields.
options.error.notPersisted: Settings were not persisted. Reload the extension and try again.
options.error.init: Settings page failed to initialize. Reload the extension and open Options again.
